title: Our Locations
description: Four waterfront locations across Seattle. Beach access, stunning views, and the perfect setting for hot-cold cycles.

items.name: Golden Gardens
items.address: South of the Bathhouse, just before the traffic circle. Stunning Puget Sound views.

items.name: Alki Beach
items.address: On the boardwalk, slightly west of the Alki Beach Bathhouse. West Seattle's iconic beach.

items.name: Old Stove (Ballard)
items.address: Old Stove's Gardens Location on NW 49th St. East side of the outdoor beer garden.

items.name: Leschi
items.address: Dockside on Lake Washington off Lakeside Ave. Parking available at public lot next to BluWater Bistro.
